controls.name: Closure evidence completeness and SHA-256 integrity
controls.detail: All mandatory IAM/PAM evidence is present and hashed.

controls.name: Periodic access recertification governance
controls.detail: Recertification records are deterministic, reviewable and non-executing.

controls.name: Final separation of duties
controls.detail: IAM role separation and PAM dual-control approval are both certified.

controls.name: Expiration and revocation lifecycle
controls.detail: Privileged access lifecycle includes revocation and formal closure.

controls.name: Final PAM governance
controls.detail: No standing admin; privileged session remains non-materialized and non-executing.

controls.name: No real IAM/PAM side effects during closure
controls.detail: Closure remains evidence-only and does not alter real privileges or credentials.

controls.name: No secret values exposed
controls.detail: No raw credential or secret value is exposed in closure evidence.

controls.name: Closed component preservation
controls.detail: Runtime SHA-256 preservation is enforced by the PowerShell master.
